label: Piano close, drums wide
why: Bringing the piano in front of you puts the melody in your hands.

label: Just piano and drums
why: Strip it back to hear the piano riff against the beat.

label: Bring the guitar forward
why: The guitar is quiet in this song; moving it close makes it heard.

label: Echo on the piano
why: A tempo-synced echo makes the piano sparkle around you.

label: Muffle everything but drums
why: Darkening the other parts makes the drums jump out.

label: Loop the last section
why: Repeating the end gives you a loop to arrange.
